title: Homelab Nodes
description: Per-node CPU, memory, load, disk, temperature and network for the Pi cluster.

targets.expr: (node_load1 / on (instance) count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"})) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

panels.title: Disk I/O busy
panels.description: Fraction of time the busiest disk had I/O in flight.

panels.title: SMART alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts from the smartctl exporter's rules; details on prometheus.kubecluster/alerts.

panels.title: Endurance used
panels.description: NVMe 'percentage used' of rated endurance. Alert at 80%; plan a replacement (wiki Replacing-a-Node-SSD).

panels.title: Available spare
panels.description: Spare blocks left; the drive's own threshold is 10%.

panels.title: Drive temp
panels.description: Alert above 75°C for 10 min; the drives throttle at 85°C.

panels.title: Written
panels.description: Lifetime writes. The 970 EVO Plus 500GB is rated 300 TBW, the 990 PRO 1TB 600 TBW.

panels.title: Drives reporting
panels.description: Nodes whose NVMe drive passes its SMART self-assessment (4 = all).
